## New York State Analysis

```{r}
#| label: nys-subset
nys_clean <- master_clean %>%
  mutate(GEOID = str_pad(as.character(GEOID), width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%
  filter(str_sub(GEOID, 1, 2) == "36")

nrow(nys_clean)   #NY has 62 counties
```

## #NYS data
```{r}
#domestic violence 2019
#| label: nys-dv-join
#| include: false

dv_2019 <- read_excel("data/nys_dv_2019_clean.xlsx", sheet = "Wide (per county)")

# Join onto the NY-only county dataset (built earlier)
nys_clean <- nys_clean %>%
  mutate(name_clean = str_remove(name, " County.*$")) %>%
  left_join(dv_2019, by = c("name_clean" = "County")) %>%
  select(-name_clean)

# Check: how many counties failed to match (expect the 5 NYC counties, since
# the DV file doesn't cover them)
nys_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.na(dv_total_victims_2019)) %>%
  pull(name)
```

```{r}
#| label: nys-dv-join
#| include: false

dv_2019 <- read_excel("data/nys_dv_2019_clean.xlsx", sheet = "Wide (per county)")

nys_clean <- nys_clean %>%
  mutate(name_clean = str_remove(name, " County.*$"),
         name_clean = str_remove_all(name_clean, "\\.")) %>%   # <- drop periods (e.g. "St." -> "St")
  left_join(dv_2019, by = c("name_clean" = "County")) %>%
  select(-name_clean)

# Re-check: should now be ONLY the 5 NYC counties
nys_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.na(dv_total_victims_2019)) %>%
  pull(name)
```

```{r}
identical(nys_clean$dv_total_victims_2019.x, nys_clean$dv_total_victims_2019.y)

nys_clean <- nys_clean %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x"))

names(nys_clean)  
```
